content:
The finite confirmation campaign is ready. It measures an actual AWQ4bit Qwen2.5-7B endpoint on this RTX2080Ti host, with real public user/tool-observation content and actual generated histories. Its burst arrivals and waits are simulated. It cannot establish a production endpoint capacity or a Qwen3 hybrid-model result.

- [CONFIRMATION_PLAN.json](CONFIRMATION_PLAN.json) pins all24 commands, order, four arms, two cells, three paired corpus partitions,91 executable/data/source/runtime pins, model identity, budgets, SLO definitions and failure/interpretation rules. LargeARC3072 vs smallARC/candidate/original2048 GPU blocks; every arm has4096 CPU blocks. Chat12clients/maxactive4/zero-wait and agent24/maxactive8/private0–12s waits. Original semantic is the frozen true starting source/config, with actual numerical scoring qualified.
- [shared-lookup-cpu-v3.log](qualification/shared-lookup-cpu-v3.log):302 CPU tests passed with CUDA forbidden. Includes old full-prefix paths and shared-prefix allocator/fence/ownership/rollback controls, bound actual-demand lifetime, pre-lookup callback, completion after bind, stale object/generation/prefix, finish/cancel/reset/error cleanup.
- [Final actual-model frozen-hook qualification](runs/qualify-frozen-hooks-native-bytes/qualification-summary.json):6 strict native proofs,2 actual shared-prefix native adoptions,710,148,096 transferred component bytes exact,3,670,016 local bytes unchanged through adoption. Passive completion records reconcile exactly to174,325,760 actual audited H2D bytes. Intrusive byte audits synchronize transfers and are excluded from all performance comparisons; they can mask races.
- [Original AWQ public smoke](runs/qualify-original-awq-public-chat/summary.json):8/8 valid strict native proofs;33 actual legacy numerical kernel enqueues,127 query rows,3041 block rows and32 manager relevance publications/769 updates. Actual kernel completion is evidenced by normal result publication, distinct from enqueue counters. Short smoke timings do not enter confirmation.
- [Metrics validation](metrics-validation.json):32 stdlib tests passed, versionv3-p95-itl-offline-staging-utility. Strict source/hash/physical/fence event validator is pinned. Missing resource/identity/proof/traffic joins remain unknown. Explicit completion observations cover core traffic; earlier ready-only byte sums are lower bounds.

The private candidate stages only exact contiguous missing suffix pages, preserves an exact current GPU-local prefix, and publishes synchronously immediately before the existing native cache lookup. It never waits for a transfer or a hint acknowledgement. A valid request bind transitions ready staged pages to request ownership until lookup/finish/cancel/error, so a queued request may retain GPU reservations for seconds. This is an explicit ownership-policy change with capacity cost. Both private flags remain default off, dense TP1/factor1 FP16 KV only, and canonical sources remain unchanged.

Learning evidence already prevents a plain-win claim: short-chat896MiB device-allocation savings can come entirely from right-sizing ARC; whole-prefix-only public hints produced no scoring; first shared-prefix publications were evicted during queue residence; JIT public learning produced meaningful scoring/constrained choices and5 adoptions but about52% of completed-ready bytes were consumed by the intended request. The agent burst point exceeded its15s p95TTFT SLO. Cross-arm output/history/key differences remain unresolved and disqualify exact-work99%-throughput assertions even where descriptive request/TPS ratios look close. Three different corpus partitions are paired observations, not enough for an unjustified confidence interval.

No algorithm/headroom/wait/source changes after this freeze. All24 planned results and operational failures count. Any invalid strict proof, changed pin, process contention or genuine resource failure stops execution for diagnosis, preserves evidence and does not become a cherry-picked retry. Qualification, learning screens and later intrusive quality/abandonment/open-loop diagnostics remain separate. No commit or push.
